Name: (CP) Beetle World 1.6 Fix
Author: posumundi
Description:
Are you, too, a fan of beetles? Are you, too, sad that it hasnt gotten an update for 1.6 and therefore you cant grow beetles anymore without cheating them in? Worry no more, because thanks to CP and me wanting to grow beetles with a friend again, I have made a little fix for this!

You will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8848]Beetle World Mod by JoannaGruesom3[/url]. I am NOT the author of that mod, just a fan. I did NOT modify their original code. I am merely writing this fix for 1.6 because their mod is not updated for 1.6 and IDK if they will ever return to the site or update their mod. Fixes a bug where in 1.6, you could no longer purchase grubs at Pierre's.

Really quickly done, so obviously no guarantee that it is without bugs.
